additional_info.body:
Hello Chlöe,
I checked the sessions and it seems that this is not the only time this happened. It happened 87 times this past 4 weeks.
This error is the Temperature Sensor of the DC1 are faulty. The cable needs to be replaced.
Since the charger is out of warranty, please let me know what you need from my side or if you can do it with the local colleagues.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco
